$comment: An entry here suppresses a blocking advisory ONLY until its expiry date.
REQUIRED on every entry: ghsa, package, modules, severity, reason, owner, expires.
The schema is fail-closed. A malformed entry fails the scan instead of
silently suppressing nothing; see validateAllowlist() in sca-check.mjs and
An entry stops applying if it expires OR if the advisory's severity changes
from the value reviewed here, which forces a fresh review.
Adding an entry is a maintainer decision and requires PR review.
Do not add an entry when `npm audit fix` or an `overrides` pin can resolve it.

exceptions.reason: Prototype pollution in SheetJS. No patched release exists on the npm registry; SheetJS publishes 0.20.x only from cdn.sheetjs.com. Changing the install source away from the registry is a maintainer decision that is still open.
exceptions.exposure: Reachable from POST /api/v2/certificates/:eventId/eligibility/csv, which requires an authenticated admin token. The upload has no size limit and no rate limit, so this risk is NOT currently mitigated by a compensating control.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Add multer limits and a fileFilter to the certificate upload route, or migrate off the registry build of xlsx. Tracked as SAST-06 in the maintainer security backlog.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in SheetJS. Same npm registry limitation as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6: no patched version is published to the registry, so npm audit fix cannot resolve it.
exceptions.exposure: Same admin-authenticated upload path as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6, with no upload size limit and no rate limit in place today.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Add multer limits and a fileFilter to the certificate upload route, or migrate off the registry build of xlsx. Tracked as SAST-06 in the maintainer security backlog.

exceptions.reason: Open redirect in react-router 6. The only published fix is react-router-dom 7, a breaking major upgrade in the legacy JavaScript frontend.
exceptions.exposure: client-side is the legacy frontend. No workflow in .github/workflows builds or deploys it; client-side-ts is the deployed frontend and is not affected.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Either migrate client-side to react-router-dom 7, or remove the legacy app from the repository if it is confirmed dead.

exceptions.reason: Constructor injection via SSR hydration in react-router 6. Same breaking-major limitation as GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6, and this application does not use server-side rendering.
exceptions.exposure: client-side is a client-rendered SPA with no SSR hydration path, and no workflow builds or deploys it.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Either migrate client-side to react-router-dom 7, or remove the legacy app from the repository if it is confirmed dead.

exceptions.reason: Braces remains on the 3.0.3 release in the project’s transitive dependency tree. The package has no published patch release in the registry, so an override cannot resolve it without a breaking major upgrade path.
exceptions.exposure: This is reachable through nodemon/chokidar in the server-side development toolchain and is not a runtime application dependency in production code. It is limited to local development and CI build tooling.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Replace the chokidar-based dev toolchain with a maintained watcher or upgrade the dev dependency stack after validating the project’s local workflow and Node compatibility.

exceptions.reason: The root project currently depends on concurrently 10.0.6, which pulls a nested shell-quote version affected by a command-injection advisory. There is no compatible patched release available through npm without changing the dev tooling dependency chain.
exceptions.exposure: This advisory is only reachable when developer scripts or CI commands are executed locally or in automation. It is not exposed through the repo's runtime application surface or production server endpoints.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Upgrade the dev tooling chain away from concurrently or replace the vulnerable transitive package once a maintained patched release is available, then remove this exception.

exceptions.reason: The same nested shell-quote dependency is still present in the root dev tooling chain. npm does not provide a safe patched version in the current concurrently package range, so this is a tracked exception until the tooling is refreshed.
exceptions.exposure: This is limited to local development and CI command execution. It does not affect the deployed application or user-facing service logic.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Upgrade the concurrently dependency or replace the shell command runner with a maintained alternative that avoids the vulnerable dependency tree.
